title: Rabbi Yose ben Yose
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned at the end of Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:4, and in Gittin 1:1 reporting Rabbi Yochanan. At the end of Terumot, chapter 1, he reports Rabbi Yitzchak ben Elazar. At the end of Yevamot 8:1 he disputes Rabbi Avina in the name of Rabbi Yirmeyah [bar Abba]. He is also mentioned in Sanhedrin, folio 10.

notes.text: The final דפ״י is read as folio 10; the source does not give a side. The bracketed bar Abba remains the supplied insertion.
